mapper.select: select work_id from dws_voc2_batch_push_record where reqeut_id = #{reqeutId} group by work_id limit 1
mapper.update: update dws_voc2_batch_push_record set pre_finished_data_size = pre_finished_data_size + cast(#{currentBatchTotal} AS INT) where work_id = #{workId} and pre_finished_data_size + cast(#{currentBatchTotal} AS INT)<=received_total

update dws_voc2_batch_push_record set model_miss_analysis_size = model_miss_analysis_size + cast(#{currentBatchTotal} AS INT) where work_id = #{workId} and model_miss_analysis_size + cast(#{currentBatchTotal} AS INT)<=received_total

update dws_voc2_batch_push_record set post_finished_data_size = post_finished_data_size + cast(#{currentBatchTotal} AS INT) where work_id = #{workId} and post_finished_data_size + cast(#{currentBatchTotal} AS INT)<=received_total
